def _send_data(self, rank, psn, payload):
        if self.budget == 0:
            self.c_fail += 1
            return False
        if self.budget > 0:
            self.budget -= 1
        frame = self.out_data[rank].build(psn, payload)
        self.tape.update(self.pre_data[rank])
        self.tape.update(frame)
        self.packets += 1
        self.ebytes += self.dlen
        self.c_txdata += 1
        if self.ntrace < self.tlimit:
            self.trace.append((rank, frame.hex()))
            self.ntrace += 1
        return True

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # ingress classification
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def ingress(self, rank, frame):
        n = len(frame)
        if n < 58:
            self.c_winv += 1
            return
        if frame[12] != 8 or frame[13] != 0 or frame[14] != 0x45:
            self.c_winv += 1
            return
        ip_total = (frame[16] << 8) | frame[17]
        if n != 14 + ip_total or frame[23] != 17:
            self.c_winv += 1
            return
        flags = (frame[20] << 8) | frame[21]
        if flags != 0 and flags != 0x4000:
            self.c_winv += 1
            return
        s = sum(struct.unpack('!10H', frame[14:34]))
        while s >> 16:
            s = (s & 0xFFFF) + (s >> 16)
        if s != 0xFFFF:
            self.c_winv += 1
            return
        if (frame[34] != 0x12 or frame[35] != 0xB7 or frame[36] != 0x12
                or frame[37] != 0xB7):
            self.c_winv += 1
            return
        udp_len = (frame[38] << 8) | frame[39]
        if udp_len != ip_total - 20 or frame[40] != 0 or frame[41] != 0:
            self.c_winv += 1
            return
        if frame[43] != 0 or frame[44] != 0xFF or frame[45] != 0xFF:
            self.c_winv += 1
            return
        opcode = frame[42]
        if opcode == 4:
            if frame[46] != 0 or frame[50] != 0x80:
                self.c_winv += 1
                return
            if udp_len - 24 != 4 * self.D:
                self.c_winv += 1
                return
            psn = (frame[51] << 16) | (frame[52] << 8) | frame[53]
        elif opcode == 0x11:
            if frame[46] != 0 or frame[50] != 0 or udp_len != 28:
                self.c_winv += 1
                return
            if frame[54] != 0x1F:
                self.c_winv += 1
                return
            psn = (frame[51] << 16) | (frame[52] << 8) | frame[53]
            if ((psn + 1) & MASK24) != ((frame[55] << 16) | (frame[56] << 8)
                                        | frame[57]):
                self.c_winv += 1
                return
        else:
            self.c_winv += 1
            return
        crc = bytearray(b'\xff' * 8 + bytes(frame[14:n - 4]))
        crc[9] = 0xFF
        crc[16] = 0xFF
        crc[18:20] = b'\xff\xff'
        crc[34:36] = b'\xff\xff'
        crc[40] = 0xFF
        if zlib.crc32(crc) != int.from_bytes(frame[n - 4:n], 'little'):
            self.c_winv += 1
            return
        # ---- endpoint validity ----
        if (frame[0:12] != self.e_mac[rank] or frame[26:34] != self.e_ip[rank]
                or frame[46:50] != self.e_qpn[rank]):
            self.c_einv += 1
            return
        if opcode == 4:
            p = (psn - self.start) & MASK24
            if p >= self.K or (self.prim == BCAST and rank != self.root):
                self.c_einv += 1
                return
            self._data_packet(rank, p, frame[54:54 + 4 * self.D])
            return
        self._ack_packet(rank, (psn - self.start + 1) & MASK24)

    def ingress_generated_data(self, rank, p, payload):
        """Fast path: a canonical, endpoint-valid DATA frame for logical p."""
        if self.prim == BCAST and rank != self.root:
            self.c_einv += 1
            return
        self._data_packet(rank, p, payload)

    def _data_packet(self, rank, p, payload):
        self.c_data += 1
        if p < self.b:
            self.c_stale += 1
            self.repeat[rank] = True
            self.service()
            return
        if p >= self.b + self.N:
            self.c_block += 1
            self.service()
            return
        slot = self.slots.get(p)
        if slot is not None and (slot[0] >> rank) & 1:
            self.c_dup += 1
            self.repeat[rank] = True
            self.service()
            return
        self._accept(rank, p, payload)
        self.service()

    def _ack_packet(self, rank, length):
        self.c_ack += 1
        if self.A[rank] < length <= self.S[rank]:
            self.A[rank] = length
        else:
            self.c_ign += 1
        self.service()
